title: Creamy Garlic Chicken
description: Golden seared chicken cutlets in a silky garlic parmesan cream sauce. One pan, about thirty minutes.

nutrition.source: Legacy SOUS estimate; not independently calculated and excludes serving accompaniments.

steps.title: Prep the chicken
steps.instruction: Pat the chicken dry, then slice each breast in half horizontally so you have four thin cutlets. Season both sides with the salt, pepper and paprika.
steps.tip: Thin, even cutlets cook through at the same time as the outside browns.
steps.safety: Wash your hands and the board after touching raw chicken.

steps.title: Get everything ready
steps.instruction: Mince the garlic, and measure out the broth, cream and parmesan so they're next to the stove. Things move fast once the pan is hot.

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.instruction: Set a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the olive oil. It's ready when the oil shimmers and flows easily.
steps.safety: If the oil starts smoking, the pan is too hot. Pull it off the heat for a moment and turn the burner down a notch.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.instruction: Lay the cutlets in the pan and leave them alone for four to five minutes until golden. Flip and cook three to four more minutes, until a thermometer in the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C). Move them to a clean plate.
steps.tip: If the pan is crowded, sear in two batches. Crowding steams the chicken instead of browning it.
steps.safety: Check chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) with a food thermometer; color alone is not a safety check. Use a clean plate, not the one that held raw chicken.

steps.title: Butter and garlic
steps.instruction: Turn the heat down to medium. Add the butter and the garlic, and stir constantly for about thirty to sixty seconds, just until it smells amazing. Don't let it brown.
steps.safety: Garlic burns fast and turns bitter. If it goes dark brown, wipe out the pan and start this step again with fresh butter.

steps.title: Deglaze with broth
steps.instruction: Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Let it bubble for a minute or two until it reduces by about half.
steps.tip: Those browned bits are where most of the flavor lives.

steps.title: Make the cream sauce
steps.instruction: Lower the heat to medium-low. Stir in the heavy cream, the Italian seasoning and the parmesan. Simmer gently for three to four minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. If you're using spinach, stir it in now and let it wilt.
steps.safety: Keep it at a gentle simmer. A hard boil can make a cream sauce split.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.instruction: Slide the chicken and any juices from the plate back into the sauce. Spoon sauce over the top and warm everything through for about two minutes. Taste, and add salt and pepper if it needs it.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat and scatter the parsley over the top. Serve it over pasta or rice, or with crusty bread for the sauce.

title: Tomato Beef Stew
description: A Chinese-inspired tomato and ginger beef stew with tender potatoes and a rich broth.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables and pat the beef dry. Keep the potatoes in cold water until needed, then drain.
steps.safety: Use separate boards for raw beef and vegetables; wash hands and utensils after handling beef.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in two batches for about eight minutes total, then transfer to a clean plate.

steps.title: Build the tomato base
steps.instruction: Lower to medium heat and cook the onion for five minutes. Stir in garlic, ginger and tomato paste for one minute, then add tomatoes and cook for five minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the beef
steps.instruction: Return the beef and its juices to the pot with broth, soy sauce and pepper. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently for seventy minutes, stirring occasionally.
steps.tip: Add a little water if the stew begins sticking.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.instruction: Add drained potatoes and carrots and simmer covered for twenty-five minutes. Continue cooking if needed until the beef is fork-tender and the vegetables are soft; serve hot.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Chicken Curry
description: An approachable Indian-inspired chicken curry with tomatoes, warming spices and coconut milk.

steps.title: Prepare the curry ingredients
steps.instruction: Dice the onion, mince the garlic and grate the ginger. Cut the chicken on a separate board into evenly sized pieces.
steps.safety: Keep raw poultry separate from ready-to-eat food, wash hands and utensils, and check the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion for seven minutes, stirring, then add garlic and ginger and cook for one minute.

steps.title: Add spices and chicken
steps.instruction: Stir in curry powder, cumin and salt for thirty seconds. Add chicken and stir for three minutes to coat it with the spices.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes, coconut milk and water. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for eighteen minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
steps.safety: Keep raw poultry separate from ready-to-eat food, wash hands and utensils, and check the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer.

steps.title: Finish the curry
steps.instruction: If the sauce is thin, simmer a few minutes longer; if too thick, add a splash of water. Scatter cilantro over the curry and divide among four bowls.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Bibimbap
description: Korean rice bowls with seasoned beef, sauteed vegetables, fully cooked eggs and a gochujang sauce.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.instruction: Rinse the rice and put in a saucepan with water. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for fifteen minutes, then rest off the heat for ten minutes; follow the rice package if its water ratio differs.
steps.safety: Use freshly cooked rice or rice promptly refrigerated within two hours. Reheat refrigerated rice to 165°F (74°C).

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.instruction: Mix gochujang, rice vinegar and sugar in a small bowl. Prepare the vegetables while the rice cooks.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.instruction: Heat one tablespoon neutral oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook carrot for three minutes, zucchini for three minutes and spinach for one minute in separate batches; set each aside.

steps.title: Cook the beef
steps.instruction: In the same skillet, cook beef with garlic and soy sauce for six to eight minutes, breaking it up until it reaches 160°F (71°C). Stir in sesame oil and transfer to a clean bowl.
steps.safety: Check ground beef reaches 160°F (71°C) with a food thermometer; color alone does not show it is safe.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.instruction: Heat the remaining tablespoon neutral oil over medium heat. Fry the eggs until both whites and yolks are firm, covering the pan briefly if needed.
steps.safety: Wash hands after handling eggs and cook both yolks and whites until firm.

steps.title: Assemble the bowls
steps.instruction: Divide rice between two bowls. Arrange vegetables and beef on top, add an egg to each, then sprinkle sesame seeds and serve with the sauce to mix through.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Quick skillet shrimp with garlic butter, lemon and fresh parsley.

steps.title: Prepare the shrimp
steps.instruction: Pat thawed shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper. Mince the garlic and chop the parsley.
steps.safety: Thaw shrimp in the refrigerator, keep chilled until cooking, and wash hands after handling raw seafood.

steps.title: Sear the shrimp
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil and one tablespoon butter over medium-high heat. Add shrimp in one layer and cook for two minutes, then flip.

steps.title: Add garlic butter
steps.instruction: Lower to medium heat and add remaining butter and garlic. Stir for two to three minutes until shrimp are firm, pearly and opaque throughout; remove promptly when cooked.
steps.safety: Shrimp must be opaque throughout; do not rely only on exterior pink color.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat. Stir in lemon juice and parsley and divide the shrimp and sauce between two plates.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Spaghetti Pomodoro
description: Spaghetti tossed with a simple garlic, tomato and basil sauce.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: divided; one and a half for pasta water

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.instruction: Heat oil over medium-low heat in a wide pan. Cook garlic for one minute without browning, then add tomatoes, half a teaspoon salt and pepper.

steps.title: Simmer the tomatoes
steps.instruction: Simmer the sauce gently for twenty minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile bring the water and remaining salt to a boil in a large pot.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.instruction: Cook spaghetti in the boiling water for the package's al dente time, usually eight to eleven minutes. Reserve half a cup of pasta water, then drain carefully.
steps.safety: Keep your face and hands away from rising steam when draining.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.instruction: Toss spaghetti with sauce and basil over low heat for one minute. Add reserved pasta water a little at a time if needed, then serve with parmesan.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Chickpea Spinach Curry
description: A filling meat-free tomato curry with chickpeas and spinach.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.instruction: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger and wash the spinach.

steps.title: Cook the aromatics
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion for six minutes, then stir in garlic, ginger and curry powder for one minute.

steps.title: Simmer the chickpeas
steps.instruction: Add chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and salt. Simmer uncovered for fifteen minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.instruction: Add spinach in handfuls and stir for two minutes until wilted. Turn off the heat, stir in lemon juice and serve hot.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Miso Soup
description: A light Japanese soup with tofu, wakame and miso stirred in gently at the end.

steps.title: Prepare tofu and scallions
steps.instruction: Drain the tofu and cut into small cubes. Wash and thinly slice the scallions.

steps.title: Heat the broth
steps.instruction: Bring dashi to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Add wakame and simmer for three minutes to rehydrate it.

steps.title: Warm the tofu
steps.instruction: Add tofu carefully and simmer gently for two minutes until hot. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Stir in miso
steps.instruction: Whisk miso with a ladle of warm broth in a small bowl until smooth, then stir it back into the pot. Add scallions and serve immediately; avoid boiling after adding miso.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Teriyaki Salmon
description: Oven-baked salmon brushed with a homemade soy and ginger glaze.

steps.title: Prepare the oven
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Oil a baking dish and place salmon skin-side down in it.
steps.safety: Keep raw fish and its utensils separate from cooked food; wash hands after handling.

steps.title: Make the glaze
steps.instruction: Simmer soy sauce, water, honey, vinegar, ginger and garlic in a small saucepan for four minutes until slightly thickened. Set aside half in a clean bowl for serving.

steps.title: Bake the salmon
steps.instruction: Brush salmon with the remaining glaze. Bake for twelve to sixteen minutes, until a thermometer in the thickest part reads 145°F (63°C).
steps.safety: Cooking time depends on thickness; use a thermometer and do not reuse a brush that touched raw fish on cooked salmon.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.instruction: Spoon the reserved clean glaze over the cooked salmon and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Divide between two plates.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: A quick Chinese-inspired skillet rice with peas, carrots and scrambled eggs.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.instruction: Break up chilled rice clumps with a fork. Dice carrot, mince garlic and slice scallions; beat eggs in a bowl.
steps.safety: Use freshly cooked rice or rice promptly refrigerated within two hours. Reheat refrigerated rice to 165°F (74°C).

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.instruction: Heat one tablespoon neutral oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Scramble eggs for two minutes until set, then transfer to a clean plate.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.instruction: Add remaining neutral oil and carrot to the pan and cook for four minutes. Add peas, garlic and scallions and stir for two minutes.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.instruction: Add rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for five minutes, breaking up any clumps. Return eggs and stir in sesame oil; heat everything to 165°F (74°C), then serve.
steps.safety: Use freshly cooked rice or rice promptly refrigerated within two hours. Reheat refrigerated rice to 165°F (74°C).

title: Homemade Tacos
description: Weeknight ground beef tacos with crisp lettuce, tomatoes and a simple spice blend.

steps.title: Prepare the toppings
steps.instruction: Wash and shred lettuce, dice tomatoes and onion, grate cheese and cut lime into wedges. Keep the toppings away from raw beef.

steps.title: Cook the beef
steps.instruction: Heat oil over medium-high heat and cook onion for three minutes. Add beef and cook for seven minutes, breaking it into crumbles, until it reaches 160°F (71°C); carefully drain excess fat.
steps.safety: Check ground beef reaches 160°F (71°C) with a food thermometer; color alone does not show it is safe.

steps.title: Season the filling
steps.instruction: Stir in cumin, chili powder, salt, tomato paste and water. Simmer for four minutes until the filling is moist but not watery.

steps.title: Warm and fill tortillas
steps.instruction: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for about thirty seconds per side. Divide beef among tortillas and top with lettuce, tomatoes and cheese; serve with lime wedges.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Crisp folded tortillas filled with seasoned black beans, corn and melted cheese.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.instruction: Drain and rinse beans and thaw corn. Mash half the beans, then mix with remaining beans, corn, cumin, salt and lime juice.

steps.title: Fill the tortillas
steps.instruction: Divide the filling and cheese over one half of each tortilla. Fold the empty halves over and gently press flat.

steps.title: Cook in batches
steps.instruction: Heat one teaspoon oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook two quesadillas for three minutes per side until crisp and hot throughout; repeat with remaining oil and quesadillas.
steps.safety: Turn down the heat if tortillas brown before the cheese melts.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.instruction: Rest for one minute so the filling settles. Cut each quesadilla into wedges and serve two per person.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Greek Chickpea Salad
description: A fresh chickpea salad with cucumber, tomatoes, olives and feta in a lemon dressing.

steps.title: Wash and chop
steps.instruction: Wash cucumber and tomatoes, then dice cucumber and halve tomatoes. Dice onion, slice olives and drain and rinse chickpeas.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.instruction: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and pepper in a large bowl.

steps.title: Toss the salad
steps.instruction: Add chickpeas, vegetables and olives and toss well. Fold in feta gently so it stays in small pieces.

steps.title: Serve or chill
steps.instruction: Divide among four bowls, or cover and refrigerate until serving. Stir once more before serving to redistribute the dressing.
steps.safety: Keep the salad refrigerated at 40°F (4°C) or below and refrigerate within two hours of preparation.

title: Lentil Vegetable Soup
description: A hearty Mediterranean-inspired soup with brown lentils, tomatoes and vegetables.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.instruction: Rinse lentils and remove any debris. Dice onion, carrots and celery and mince garlic.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook onion, carrots and celery for seven minutes; stir in garlic for one minute.

steps.title: Cook the lentils
steps.instruction: Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, thyme and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered for thirty minutes, until lentils are tender; add water if needed.

steps.title: Finish the soup
steps.instruction: Stir in lemon juice. For a thicker soup, mash a few lentils against the side of the pot; divide among four bowls.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, served with bread.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook diced onion and pepper for eight minutes until soft, stirring regularly.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.instruction: Add garlic, cumin, paprika and salt and cook for one minute. Stir in tomatoes and simmer uncovered for twelve minutes until thickened.

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.instruction: Make four wells in the sauce and crack one egg into each. Cover and cook on low for eight to ten minutes until both whites and yolks are firm.
steps.safety: Cook eggs until whites and yolks are firm; wash hands after handling shells.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.instruction: Scatter parsley over the eggs and sauce. Divide between two plates and serve with bread for scooping.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Thai Basil Chicken
description: A Thai-inspired chicken stir-fry with basil and a savory garlic sauce.

ingredients.name: red chili
ingredients.note: sliced; remove seeds for less heat

steps.title: Prepare sauce and ingredients
steps.instruction: Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and water in a bowl. Prepare garlic, chili and beans, then chop chicken on a separate board.
steps.safety: Keep raw poultry separate from ready-to-eat food, wash hands and utensils, and check the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer.

steps.title: Start the stir-fry
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir-fry garlic and chili for thirty seconds, then add chicken and cook for five minutes, stirring often.

steps.title: Cook with the sauce
steps.instruction: Add beans and prepared sauce. Cook for five to seven minutes until beans are tender-crisp and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C); add a splash of water if the pan dries out.
steps.safety: Keep raw poultry separate from ready-to-eat food, wash hands and utensils, and check the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer.

steps.title: Add basil and serve
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat and fold in basil until wilted. Serve over the freshly cooked rice.
steps.safety: Use freshly cooked rice or rice promptly refrigerated within two hours. Reheat refrigerated rice to 165°F (74°C).

title: Lemon Herb Chicken
description: Roasted chicken thighs and potatoes with lemon, garlic and oregano.

steps.title: Start the potatoes
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss potatoes with one tablespoon oil, half the salt and half the pepper on a rimmed baking sheet; roast for fifteen minutes.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.instruction: Mix remaining oil, salt and pepper with lemon juice, garlic and oregano in a bowl. Add chicken and turn to coat.
steps.safety: Keep raw poultry separate from ready-to-eat food, wash hands and utensils, and check the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer.

steps.title: Roast together
steps.instruction: Turn potatoes and add chicken to the sheet in one layer. Roast for twenty to twenty-five minutes until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
steps.safety: Keep raw poultry separate from ready-to-eat food, wash hands and utensils, and check the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.instruction: Rest the chicken for five minutes, then divide chicken and potatoes among four plates. Discard any uncooked marinade left in the bowl.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).

title: Avocado Pasta
description: Pasta with a fresh avocado, lemon and basil sauce, best eaten immediately.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Bring water and one teaspoon salt to a boil. Cook pasta for the package's al dente time, usually eight to ten minutes; reserve half a cup cooking water before draining.
steps.safety: Drain carefully to avoid steam burns.

steps.title: Prepare the produce
steps.instruction: Wash the avocado skin before cutting, then remove the pit and scoop out the flesh. Wash basil and tomatoes and halve tomatoes.

steps.title: Blend the sauce
steps.instruction: Blend avocado, lemon juice, olive oil, basil, garlic, remaining salt and pepper with two tablespoons reserved pasta water until smooth. Add more reserved water a spoonful at a time if needed.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.instruction: Toss drained pasta with avocado sauce off the heat. Fold in tomatoes and serve immediately; refrigerate leftovers promptly and use within one day for best quality.
steps.safety: Refrigerate within two hours; the sauce will darken during storage.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice with browned mushrooms and parmesan, made without wine.

steps.title: Prepare and warm the broth
steps.instruction: Slice mushrooms, dice onion and mince garlic. Heat broth in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Cook mushrooms for seven minutes until browned; transfer to a bowl.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.instruction: Lower the heat to medium and melt one tablespoon butter in the pan. Cook onion for four minutes, garlic for thirty seconds, then stir in rice for two minutes.

steps.title: Add broth gradually
steps.instruction: Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and adding more when nearly absorbed. Continue for twenty to twenty-five minutes until rice is tender with a slight bite; you may not need all the broth.
steps.tip: Keep a gentle simmer rather than a hard boil.

steps.title: Finish the risotto
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat and stir in mushrooms, remaining butter, parmesan, pepper and lemon juice. Add a little warm broth if needed so the risotto flows gently, then serve immediately.
steps.safety: Use freshly cooked rice or rice promptly refrigerated within two hours. Reheat refrigerated rice to 165°F (74°C).

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Thin slices of beef and crisp broccoli in a quick soy and ginger sauce.

steps.title: Prepare the sauce
steps.instruction: Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch, sugar and a quarter cup water. Prepare broccoli, garlic and ginger, then thinly slice beef on a separate board.
steps.safety: Wash hands and utensils after handling raw beef.

steps.title: Steam the broccoli
steps.instruction: Heat one tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and remaining quarter cup water, cover for three minutes, then uncover and transfer broccoli to a bowl.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.instruction: Add remaining oil and sear beef in a single layer, in batches if needed, for about four minutes, turning once. Check representative thick slices reach 145°F (63°C), then transfer to a clean plate and rest three minutes.
steps.safety: Use a food thermometer; whole-cut beef needs 145°F (63°C) and a three-minute rest.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.instruction: Lower heat to medium, add garlic and ginger and stir for thirty seconds. Stir the sauce mixture again, pour into the pan and simmer for two minutes until glossy.

steps.title: Bring together
steps.instruction: Return rested beef and broccoli to the pan and toss for one minute until coated and hot. Divide between two plates and serve immediately.
steps.safety: Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within two hours, use within three to four days, and reheat to 165°F (74°C).
